# IndiBrick Financial

> Ontario's integrated mortgage, real estate, and legal platform. Licensed mortgage brokerage serving GTA, Vaughan, Brampton, and Niagara. Mortgages processed through Pineapple Financial (LIC #12830).

## What we do

- Wholesale mortgage brokerage: insured, insurable, uninsured, B-lender, private capital
- Real estate co-brokerage through licensed realtor partner network
- Tech-enabled legal closings (fixed-fee, digital signing)
- Architecture, renovation permitting, and wealth strategy
- Pre-construction investment advisory

## Mortgage products

See current pricing on the live rates page: https://indibrick.ca/rates

- Insured (high-ratio) mortgages — variable and fixed
- Insurable renewals and transfers
- Uninsured refinances
- Alternative B-lender mortgages
- Private capital / asset-based mortgages
- Second mortgages up to 85% LTV

## Who we serve

First-time buyers, investors, self-employed borrowers, credit-challenged homeowners, real estate investors, commercial borrowers, pre-construction buyers.

## Service areas

Vaughan, Woodbridge, Brampton, Mississauga, Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Markham, Richmond Hill, St. Catharines, Niagara Region.
